scientific_integrity: Proof is analytic; a finite-dose standard-library checker checks explicit numerical identities only. The source model and earlier pre-adapted monotonicity theorems are credited. Independent mathematical and historical assessments are not performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite fixed horizon, normalized scalar IFFL1 model, nonnegative input-independent initial states. The explicit threshold is necessary and sufficient only for negative initial slope, and sufficient (not necessary) for global nonmonotonicity. No uniqueness or location of the global minimum, larger-network theorem, finite-dose error estimate or biological parameter calibration is claimed.
title: A universal logarithmic high-dose law and an initial-load reversal of cumulative response
